notes.text: Plan: new worktops and sink. Budget 9,000 EUR (estimate, 1 September 2026).

steps.text: Email from Tõnis Kask (electrician), 5 October 2026: Rewiring the kitchen and hallway will cost 3,800 EUR. Work can start 2 November and takes five working days. The fuse board must be replaced first; this is included in the price.

Note from the city building office, 12 October 2026: Replacing the kitchen worktops and sink needs no building permit. Moving the load-bearing wall between the kitchen and hallway would need a permit; processing takes about 30 days.
Message from Liis, 19 October 2026: Lovely to see you at the choir on Sunday! By the way, my cousin did her kitchen last year and loved her new tiles.
Tõnis Kask, 26. oktoober 2026: Elektritööde algus lükkub 9. novembrile, sest kilp saabub hiljem. Hind jääb samaks.
Kitchen quote from Puidukoda, dated 28 September 2026: worktops and sink 7,600 EUR including installation; valid until 31 October 2026.

steps.prompt: The renovation is getting bigger. Please organize my renovation notes so I can find things: make sure there is a sensible topic page and that the Topics note lists it.
Give me the current state of the renovation: the known costs, the electrical start date, and anything that needs my decision. Don't change anything.

cases.rubric: Chronology and attribution kept; the expired quote and the 11,400 EUR vs 9,000 EUR budget overrun surfaced; the permit point surfaced; organization readable.
